diff --git a/test/units/executor/test_final_queue_display.py b/test/units/executor/test_final_queue_display.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2c809d3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/executor/test_final_queue_display.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+from queue import Queue
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import call
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import _sentinel, results_thread_main
+
+
+def test_final_queue_transports_display_arguments():
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    try:
+        queue.send_display(u'message', 'blue', stderr=True, newline=False)
+        event = queue.get(timeout=5)
+        assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+        assert event.args == (u'message', 'blue')
+        assert event.kwargs == {'stderr': True, 'newline': False}
+    finally:
+        queue.close()
+        queue.join_thread()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_replays_all_display_events(mocker):
+    display_call = mocker.patch('ansible.plugins.strategy.display.display')
+    queue = Queue()
+    queue.put(DisplaySend(u'first', stderr=True))
+    queue.put(DisplaySend(u'second', newline=False))
+    queue.put(_sentinel)
+
+    results_thread_main(SimpleNamespace(_final_q=queue))
+
+    assert display_call.call_args_list == [
+        call(u'first', stderr=True),
+        call(u'second', newline=False),
+    ]
diff --git a/test/units/utils/display/test_display.py b/test/units/utils/display/test_display.py
index cdeb496..64eed0e 100644
--- a/test/units/utils/display/test_display.py
+++ b/test/units/utils/display/test_display.py
@@ -6,6 +6,9 @@ from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
 __metaclass__ = type
 
 
+import pytest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
 from ansible.utils.display import Display
 
 
@@ -18,3 +21,47 @@ def test_display_basic_message(capsys, mocker):
     out, err = capsys.readouterr()
     assert out == 'Some displayed message\n'
     assert err == ''
+
+
+def test_display_queue_is_worker_only(monkeypatch):
+    d = Display()
+    queue = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_final_q', None)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        d.set_queue(queue)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.utils.display.os.getpid', lambda: d._parent_pid + 1)
+    d.set_queue(queue)
+    assert d._final_q is queue
+
+
+def test_display_forwards_all_arguments_without_writing(capsys, monkeypatch):
+    d = Display()
+    queue = MagicMock()
+    lock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_final_q', queue)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_lock', lock)
+
+    d.display(u'worker message', color='red', stderr=True, screen_only=True,
+              log_only=False, newline=False)
+
+    queue.send_display.assert_called_once_with(u'worker message', 'red', True, True, False, False)
+    lock.__enter__.assert_not_called()
+    assert capsys.readouterr() == ('', '')
+
+
+def test_display_locks_parent_output(monkeypatch):
+    d = Display()
+    lock = MagicMock()
+    write = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_final_q', None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_lock', lock)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(d, '_display', write)
+
+    d.display(u'parent message')
+
+    lock.__enter__.assert_called_once_with()
+    lock.__exit__.assert_called_once()
+    write.assert_called_once_with(u'parent message', color=None, stderr=False,
+                                  screen_only=False, log_only=False, newline=True)
